# sQdthOne

sQdthOne offers balanced light and dark modes with eye-friendly HSL colours and reduced saturation for long writing sessions. It names Style Settings and Calendar as compatible plugins and adds checklist icons plus refined file-tree, outline, menu and list styling.

![sQdthOne screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keithlerner/ObsidianMDsQdthOne/HEAD/GitCapture.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "sQdthOne"
    author: "keithlerner"
    repo:   "keithlerner/ObsidianMDsQdthOne"
    slug:   "sqdthone"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sqdthone"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/keithlerner/ObsidianMDsQdthOne"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keithlerner/ObsidianMDsQdthOne/HEAD/GitCapture.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Switch to sQdthOne for balanced light and dark modes with eye-friendly HSL colors and reduced saturation for long writing sessions. Enable compatible Style Settings and Calendar plugins and enjoy special checklist icons plus refined file-tree, outline, menu, and list styling for consistent readability."
}
```
